character-tracker.settings.recordWithout: Record Changes When No GM Is Online

If enabled, changes players make while no GM is logged in are saved on the character by the player's own client, then added to the log the next time a GM logs in. Because these entries are stored on a character the player owns, a determined player could edit them before a GM logs in, so they are marked in the log.
